Name: (CP) Shiny Grandpa Shrines
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
[font=Tahoma][b][size=4]Updated for 1.6![/size][/b][/font][font=Tahoma]

Brighten up Grandpa's shrine with some shiny popping colors! Currently comes in 4 colors:

[/font][list]
[*][b][font=Tahoma][color=#ff0000]Ruby[/color][/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Tahoma][color=#ff7700]Orpiment[/color][/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Tahoma][color=#ffff00]Pure Gold[/color][/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Tahoma][color=#00ff00]Emerald[/color][/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Tahoma][color=#00ffff]Diamond[/color][/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Tahoma][color=#3c78d8]Mermaid Blue[/color][/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Tahoma][color=#1155cc]Sapphire[/color][/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Tahoma][color=#9900ff]Iridium Purple[/color][/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Tahoma][color=#ff00ff]Star Shard[/color][/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Tahoma]Lunarite[/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Tahoma][color=#cccccc]Old Master White [/color][/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Tahoma][color=#000000]Obsidian[/color][/font][/b]
[/list][font=Tahoma][color=#1155cc][b]
[/b][/color][/font][font=Tahoma]If there are any other colors you'd like to see, let me know!

[b]NOW COMPATIBLE WITH MAP RECOLOR MODS![/b]

--

[/font][size=2][b]To install--[/b][/size]
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. After first run, go into the generated config.json (can be opened using [url=https://notepad-plus-plus.org/]Notepad++[/url] or program of your choice) to choose your desired color (default is Ruby).  Alternatively, use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to make your choice in-game.﻿
4. Load up your game and enjoy!

--
[b]Original Content Patcher version, thanks to [color=#f1f1f1][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/27024274]pepoluan[/url]! [/color][/b]
